# N1-E1 verification — Historical evidence and Statistics parity

N1-E1 implements inactive, private, allocation-free analysis and compatibility inputs in the separate `ItacanTaskCore/history/` entry. It creates no import writer, prepared native plan, task, Step, event, binding, receipt, reservation or schema change. E2 remains a separately reviewed gate. No production activation, migration, installation, Obsidian reload/restart or N1-F implementation occurred.

## Scope and safety baseline

All pre-edit scans completed sequentially and were awaited before the first implementation output. The fresh baseline covers **2,604 files**, **457 preexisting Git status entries**, an empty existing-file edit allowlist and exactly thirteen authorized new paths. No existing source, earlier test/report or frozen observation was edited. No originals required copying because every authorized implementation path was new; existing bytes and dirty status were hashed and preserved.

The baseline verifies all **143 B2 archive files** and **22 current reviewed B2 files** against their sealed inventory. Nineteen predecessor archives were checked; thirteen historical full manifests cover 1,917 verified archived files. Earlier archives without full manifests retain their documented narrower evidence level. No reconstruction is represented as an original simultaneous snapshot.

The phase archive is `System/Backups/itacan-n1e1-20261017-11a62738/`. It retains the completed baseline, explicit inventories, original/corrected verification wrapper, all attempt logs, frozen E1 observations, pre/postflight health, before/after staged assets, final safety report, thirteen reviewed outputs and per-file SHA256 inventory. The archive inventory hash/count are reported at completion. Archive verification is independent of executable test claims.

## Implemented contracts and decisions

`HistoryCaptureV1` pins exact ordered raw rows/checks and their revisions, source lineage, private scope, registry, published N1-B plan/snapshot and verified N1-C source envelopes. Stable row keys use capture identity/ordinal. Optional exact byte envelopes retain whitespace/CRLF/escapes and otherwise unrepresentable evidence. Unknown versions, digest corruption, foreign targets, missing target dispositions and source disagreement reject. Opaque/unparseable evidence remains explicitly unavailable; it never produces successful empty totals.

Analysis/proposal/projection call no identity allocator or repository API. Tests prepare synthetic N1-B memory snapshots outside the functions under test. Analysis retains `nativeEventId:null`, zero allocation/import counters, `nativeImportImplemented:false`, and no production authority. `proposeImportBundle` is a reviewed, digested **unexecutable evidence proposal**, not an E2 preparation transaction. E1's API can be loaded with filesystem, storage, process and UI imports denied.

| Policy | E1 result | Remaining requirement |
|---|---|---|
| E01 | Entire tree quarantined if any completed target lacks proof; raw checked state preserved | E2 publication enforcement |
| E02 | Exact published alias, one explicit current check, surviving event, correct kind/parent/source/owner and consistent time | Establish binding only in E2 atomic import |
| E03 | Type-sensitive truthy-ID groups; identical duplicates retain all row references; falsey/missing occurrence identities separate; conflicting groups have no canonical winner | Stable prepared canonical UUIDs |
| E04 | Every row accounted for; quarantined/unbound evidence remains in ordered compatibility input | Durable private envelope/projection metadata |
| E05 | Raw chart timestamp unchanged; proven integral current completion time or explicit null; archive-derived time not guessed | Separate original recordedAt/importedAt in E2 |
| E06 | No event allocation or planning store | Native repository preparation |
| E07 | Published pinned N1-B and verified N1-C synthetic evidence only; immutable plan untouched | Live coordination stays N3 |
| E08 | Exact reviewed pins; same lineage or overlapping source ID/path blocks | Durable one-capture conflict rules |
| E09 | No marker manipulation or import replay API | Existing persistent fence integration in E2 |

Missing History, old locator-only checks, conflicting/stale checks, copied aliases, cross-owner bindings, wrong Step parents, unresolved Phase/location/content, incompatible dates, legacy recurrence and archive-time uncertainty remain explicit blockers. No event, chain, owner or timestamp is inferred from title, line, current note location or latest-event ordering. Open targets may retain historical events without inventing reopening; missing/deleted targets do not require artificial live parents. An individual candidate binding inside a quarantined tree is diagnostic only; the usable `analysis.bindings` set excludes the entire tree.

Both shared Projects (synthetic Itacan and Obsidian Hub registrations), the private Project and all four Resources have executed exact-binding cases. Mounted working context leaves physical Resource ownership unchanged. Historical Statistics cohorts additionally cover deleted/inactive/unassigned owners, moved/missing notes and owner/kind conflicts. The synthetic vectors contain no captured private user History.

## Actual-helper parity

The test harness calls the existing production `queryHistory`, `recordedHistoryQuery`, `statisticsCompletions`, `prepareStatistics` and `aggregateStatistics`, plus actual `historyRecords` for display. It does not implement a second legacy calculator or instantiate production startup. `taskProgressMutation` executes actual reopen/recomplete/deletion behavior. The existing isolated host seam also demonstrates a completed Markdown source surviving History-save failure without a recorded event.

The new frozen version-1 corpus contains **47 input cases**, **15 selected current-source hashes** and observations for **three time zones**: UTC, Europe/Stockholm and America/New_York. Inputs, clocks and outputs are frozen separately from policy text. It was captured once into OS Temp and copied to its authorized new fixture path; tests cannot regenerate it. N1-A evidence was rerun unchanged and was not recaptured.

For every corpus input, tests compare the **complete actual aggregate**, preparation and History display results from original rows versus projected input, across all five ranges and every discovered workspace. Frozen digests further pin whole preparation, aggregates and display; asserted numeric examples independently guard important edge cases. Failures/unavailability are compared as failures, not converted to empty charts.

Verified semantics include numeric `7` versus string `"7"`, missing/null/empty/zero/false IDs, truthy `"0"`, cross-owner and task/Step ID collisions, invalid-first/valid-first/future-first duplicates, fractional/null/missing/negative/string/out-of-range times, archive evidence, display duplicates and raw stored order. Global dedup precedes timestamp rejection and workspace/range selection. No timestamp coercion, fractional rounding, dedup repair or owner prefilter was added.

Calendar cases exercise all five ranges, boundary instants, month/year/leap transitions, both Stockholm DST transitions, and All-time bin changes at 100/101 and 730/731 days. Full aggregates preserve activity, last-active order, historical cohorts, earliest contribution, bins, reports/work distribution, notes, Oath sessions and derived metrics. The Statistics UI remains All time; actual internal `aggregateStatistics` still defaults to `3m`. Unrelated production metrics and inputs are unchanged.

Pure lifecycle specimens suppress only the entire raw group of an eligible proven reopened binding, retaining immutable evidence. Represented canonical events are not appended again. Genuine native specimen events are sorted by committed revision/index and counted once; collisions/ambiguous positions reject. These are projection simulations, not evidence of implemented import or persisted lifecycle reconciliation. Minimal genuine records fabricate no source navigation or departed-owner label; current workspace inputs supply current labels. E2 must separately preserve any required historical native-owner label evidence.

All mutable checks were guarded to synthetic memory or OS Temp. Runtime was the existing VS Code Electron-as-Node 24.21.0; strict declarations used existing TypeScript 6.0.3 without installation. Full explicit paths and logs are archived.

All checks completed and their child processes were awaited. After all twelve earlier inventories and eight declaration processes passed, the PowerShell wrapper stalled serializing decorated `Get-Content` strings into its final combined report. Only that verified wrapper shell was stopped. Raw logs and the original script remain; declaration results were summarized directly from unchanged zero-diagnostic logs. This was reporting, not a test interruption or rerun. Earlier test results had already been saved individually.

All attempt logs are retained. The Temp-only guard correctly refused the initial fixture generator's direct workspace write; the generator then wrote to Temp and its output was copied to the authorized fixture path. One early lifecycle test omitted current workspace labels on its native side; supplying the same existing workspace input to both actual pipelines resolved the comparison without fabricating labels or changing production semantics. No failed attempt was recast as a passing observation or used to overwrite an earlier frozen fixture.

## Completion boundary

E1 evidence analysis, blocked mappings, reviewed identity/time policies and exact specified-corpus Statistics parity are complete. The package remains inactive/private and has no import writer. It does not prove E2 atomic import, durable allocation/retry, schema-4 compatibility, import crash/recovery fences, lifecycle persistence, shared export restrictions or live coordination; those require separately authorized implementation and verification.

The next-gate handoff is `lib/services/TASK-SERVICE-PHASE-N1-E2.md`. Any need to infer missing events, change approved Statistics semantics, weaken identity/content/recurrence, rewrite Oaths, import legacy recurrence, clear recovery fences or add another storage authority remains a stop condition.

**STOP FOR USER REVIEW AFTER N1-E1. DO NOT BEGIN E2 OR N1-F.**
